title: BrightBlog
description: BrightBlog is a user-friendly blog webpage that allows users to create posts with titles, descriptions, and images. It also enables readers to leave comments on posts, fostering engagement and interaction.

features.name: Create Blog Posts
features.description: Users can create blog posts by providing a title, description, and uploading an image.

features.name: Image Upload
features.description: Users can upload images to accompany their blog posts without restrictions on file size, format, or resolution.

features.name: Commenting System
features.description: Readers can leave comments on blog posts to share their thoughts and feedback.

features.name: Bright and Comfortable Design
features.description: The webpage will feature a bright and visually appealing color scheme to enhance user experience.

target_users: General users who want to create and interact with blog content.
data_requirements: Each blog post will store a title, description, and associated image. Comments will be stored for each post.

user_clarifications.Do you have any specific design preferen: A comfortable and bright color scheme, not too simple
